pr.title: Add CONTRIBUTING guide
pr.body:
Closes #1.

Adds `CONTRIBUTING.md` at the repository root with:
- how to install the dev requirements and run the direct-mode tests with pytest
- how to run the Studionet lifecycle script (`setup` and `judge` phases)
- PR conventions, including how to claim a bounty

Bounty payout address: 0xC27F966F8Dd499017dC5b17B2203013163b474a4

(This PR is the subject of the live Studionet demo: the address above is the demo hunter's throwaway wallet.)
